description: PublicWWW's own documentation and price list, in Markdown: query syntax and operators, websites about a topic (like:), regular expressions (snipexp:), country domains, ready-made example queries, clusters and extraction, the REST API, this MCP server, site languages, plans and prices with what each plan opens.
